candidates.title: How Light Works
candidates.observed: Direct official page read: complete explainer on visible light, photopic/scotopic vision, illuminance, magnitude and comparisons; last updated 2024-06-17.
candidates.reason: Clear authentic input; distinct from recent topics; rich contrast between physical signal, scale and perception.

candidates.title: Natural Light in the Night Sky
candidates.observed: Official page describes Moon, stars, planets, Milky Way, zodiacal light, airglow and aurora.
candidates.reason: High quality but broader catalogue structure; chosen page offers a tighter argument and better reusable language.

candidates.title: What are the northern lights? The aurora borealis explained
candidates.observed: Direct search result exposed full multi-section explainer on solar wind, atmospheric emissions, colours, cycles, location and forecasting.
candidates.reason: Likely above weekday time target and its forecasting section is too close to the 2026-10-29 lesson.

candidates.title: How the Moon got its spots
candidates.observed: Official page read; landing text identifies lunar maria and an embedded expert video, but transcript/duration were not exposed.
candidates.reason: The required input length and full video content could not be verified from the observed page.

candidates.title: Why Do Leaves Change Color in the Fall?
candidates.observed: Search result showed a substantive explainer, but direct open returned 404 during this run.
candidates.reason: Direct source was not reliably accessible at selection time.

candidates.title: Why do we have an ocean?
candidates.observed: Direct official page read; concise account of cooling, condensation, degassing and gravity; updated 2026-09-23.
candidates.reason: Authentic and current but too short for the requested weekday input.

candidates.title: Everyday Mysteries…Solved!
candidates.observed: Direct official page read; answers several short questions on animals, seasons, touchscreens and other phenomena.
candidates.reason: Fragmented multi-question list offers less coherent argument structure than the selected source.

candidates.title: Keepers of the Right Answer: Why Measurements at NIST Are Important for the Nation and the World
candidates.observed: Official search result showed a dated 2024 article linking standards to healthcare, food labels and infrastructure.
candidates.reason: Good candidate, but institutional metrology overlaps an earlier NIST lesson more than the selected perception-focused source.

candidates.title: Everyday Estimation
candidates.observed: Official reference page lists estimation skills, reference quantities and educator resources.
candidates.reason: Useful reference collection but weaker as a single authentic argumentative input.

candidates.title: Dive into the Ocean Literacy Principles with NOAA resource collections
candidates.observed: Official 2026 page surveys seven ocean-literacy principles and links to multiple collections.
candidates.reason: Broad resource hub and likely above the target time; not as focused for a two-pass routine.
